title: Added test for or query error message
body:
### Summary
 - Added small test to check error message when an object which is not an instance of ActiveRecord::Relation is passed to `#or`
 
 
### Notes
 - Also found that `"#and"` method behaves the same way, and doesn't have it's error message tested, but I wasn't able to determine where should I add the tests for the `#and` method. If I can get some insight on this I can include that to the PR as well (or open a separate one). 
 
 
 (edited)
 Thanks to @p8 I found where `and` tests were, seems we are just testing `and` [methods in merging tests](https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/39558/files) so I added a separate file for specific `and` methods
